text: Think about what the expression `odd > 4` does. It creates a boolean array where each element is `True` if the corresponding element in `odd` is greater than $$4$$, and `False` otherwise. Now, consider what `sum(odd > 4)` calculates. How does this relate to the number of `True` values in the boolean array? Finally, think about what dividing by the length of the array does to this sum.
